annotations.title: Read people to exclude from a file

description: «Исключить уже знакомых»: a CSV, TSV, TXT or XLSX file with the people the user already knows (LinkedIn links in any column) -> the profile links found (pass them as exclude_urls of create_search) and the company pages (exclude_company_urls). Part of a new search's onboarding: the first assistant call of an onboarding spends one brief (a free account has one search brief and may call each assistant once); pass the returned onboarding_id to the next calls and to create_search. [REST: POST /api/assist/exclusions]

file_name.description: The file's name with its extension.

onboarding_id.description: The onboarding id that ties the assistant calls and create_search into ONE brief. Omit it on the first call: the answer gives one; pass it to every later assistant call and to create_search of the same new search.

name: parse_exclusions_file
title: Read people to exclude from a file
